name: Statement 5.36
description: Statement 5.36 is informal prose: transient and absorbing modes are “always found in pairs.” It is not a theorem. The definitions still imply that one mode cannot be both.

elements.text: Informal prose, not a theorem. The related fact that one mode is not both transient and absorbing is proved separately.
One mode cannot be both transient and absorbing. This is not a counterexample to Statement 5.36.
